thread:
maya: Heads up — noticed a spike in schema_rejects for fncall paths and it's showing up in billing as a tool invocation. Screenshot incoming but here's an example payload that failed validation:

maya: ```json
{"tool_call": {"name": "search", "args": ["query string"]}}
```

maya: The schema expects an object `tool_call.args` -> object, not an array, so adapter never ran but console shows it as a charged tool call.

sam: ugh. can you paste the exact validator error? quick debug pls.

maya: validator: `type_mismatch: expected object got array at /tool_call/args`

chris: that explains routing — we mark as fncall-reject and route to degen model route now. current billing path: root invoke counted + route tag `tool_run_attempted` set later by adapter. If adapter never ran, billing attribution is messy.

sam: we need a deterministic rule: if schema reject happens pre-adapter, do NOT count as tool execution. i.e. tag `billing.tool_executed=false`. but worried about gaming if we make it free.

chris: agree on deterministic tag, but we should also record `validation.reason` in telemetry for auditing. sampling for fraud detection. maybe `validation.outcome = reject_pre_adapter` and `validation.rule = shape_mismatch`.

maya: and Console should surface this as "Rejected before tool execution" (orange) with a link to raw payload and sample set. right now ops just sees a spike in cost and panics.

sam: small rollout proposal: 1) add telemetry tag `billing_holdschema=false|true` (internal only) 2) Canary for 5% of traffic where billing is withheld when `reject_pre_adapter` 3) collect samples + retention 30d 4) if no abuse, flip to default.

chris: implementation note — don't add new public API fields. use internal route metadata: `route.meta.validation` and `route.meta.billing_hold`. keep it internal to avoid SDK churn.

maya: +1 on internal tag. also need an alert rule in Console: when `schema_rejects` spikes AND `billing_error` spikes within same 1h window, create a triage card.

ops-bot: deploy: starting canary rollout for `invoke-validator-fix` -> cluster eng-runtime-canary (5% traffic). CI passed: 34 tests, 2 flaky infra warnings. :rocket:

sam: i'll wire the sampling, add a debug counter in metrics (`validation.rejected_pre_adapter.sampled`) and toggle via runtime flag.

chris: also add unit tests in fn-invoke path: simulate adapter not invoked and assert `billing.tool_executed` false. cover edgecases (streaming fncall, partial parse).

maya: i'll open a Console ticket for the UX card and link to the telemetry fields. i'll also attach a short explainer for CS so they don't escalate.

sam: plan sounds good. follow-ups: (1) PR for telemetry + tests, (2) canary w/ billing hold enabled, (3) Console alert + card, (4) audit sampling job. i'll own 1+2.

chris: i'll review the PR and add the test harness. maya — add the Console mockups to the ticket.

maya: thanks. tagging @console-ui for visibility. :thumbsup:
